status: validated on folds F1–F4 (every node at least level with its best baseline on every fold; ECE ≤ 0.015); v1 on live-style inputs is worse on 12 of 16 nodes (chain +34.1 nats per game) — FINDINGS §3k

why.segments: From 2026-27 ESPN stamps every rebound with the clock of the miss it follows (100% of rebounds, v 7-12% in every month 2022-26; FINDINGS §3k). v1.1 starts every rebound segment at the miss's clock in every season (possessions.py --rebound-clock miss), so history and live inputs share one convention.
why.half_life: no sample-weight decay: every half-life worse (½ season +4.5, 1 season +1.7, 2 seasons +0.7 nats per game)
why.@team: team style kept only where it beats noise: duration, what, shot result (chain −1.3 nats per game)
why.@schedule: rest days and day of season help no decision
why.@heat: in-game form kept (+0.30 nats per game without it), except free throws (better without)
why.banded: downstream nodes see the location band's mean distance — what the engine samples (costs 0.50 nats per game v exact distance)
why.recalibrate: intercept refit on the latest training slice: neutral on all 10 nodes
why.season_day: day of season kept for event and turnover type: log loss neutral, but it removes the level bias from fouls falling through every season (F4 defensive-foul bias +2.4 → −0.6 per 1,000; mean over folds 2.1 → 1.2)
why.other: clutch, playoff weights ×2 / ×0.5, role decay 3 / 10, usage decay 8 / 30, accuracy decay 20 / 80, free-throw decay 30 / 120: not better — defaults kept
